description: This Java class 'CallerIpTrackingFilter' is a web filter that tracks and logs the client's IP address from HTTP request headers, supporting proxy headers and fallback to remote address. It conditionally sets the IP address as a request attribute based on configuration.

classes.name: CallerIpTrackingFilter
classes.description: A web filter class that captures and logs client IP addresses from HTTP headers, with conditional filtering based on configuration.

methods.name: getClientIpAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the client's IP address from request headers, checking multiple headers used by proxies, or falls back to request's remote address.

methods.name: doFilterInternal
methods.description: Overrides the filter method to conditionally handle IP tracking based on configuration, or pass through.

methods.name: handleClientIp
methods.description: Handles setting the client IP address as a request attribute if available, and ensures cleanup after filtering.

methods.name: isAsyncDispatch
methods.description: Indicates whether the filter supports asynchronous dispatch; returns false.

methods.name: shouldNotFilterErrorDispatch
methods.description: Indicates whether error dispatches should be filtered; returns false.
